newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIAN STOCKS SCORE FRESH GAINS, BLUE CHIPS FALL.
newsitem.headline: CROATIAN STOCKS SCORE FRESH GAINS, BLUE CHIPS FALL.

text.p: Croatian stocks added to their recent gains on Tuesday though both blue chips suffered losses in relatively modest trade.
* Eleven of 18 active issues rose, five fell, two closed unchanged and another traded for the first time.
* Volume shrank slightly to 14,004 units but turnover rose to 16 from last Friday's 6.4 million kuna.
* Most active food processor Podravka rose three kuna to 290 with 3,649 shares sold.
* Drugs firm Pliva dipped 20 kuna to 595 on volume of 58 units.
* The other blue chip Zagrebacka Banka's ordinary stock lost 4.90 kuna to end at 2,500.10 on volume of 2,528.
* Top gainer was Rijecka Banka, rising 35 kuna or 35 percent to 135 kuna from late in July. It sold 500 shares.
* Hotelier Riviera, losing eight kuna or 4.37 percent to 175 kuna with 806 shares traded, led decliners.
* Market debutant pig breeder Svinjogojski Rasplodni Centar closed at 4,280 kuna, selling 1,463 shares.
